query:
SELECT i.tag, COUNT(*) as qtd_itens, ROUND(SUM(i.custo), 2) as total
FROM item_despesa_importado i
JOIN periodo_custo pc ON i.periodoCustoId = pc.id
WHERE pc.mes = 4 AND pc.ano = 2026
  AND i.tag NOT IN (SELECT codigoTag FROM equipamentos WHERE codigoTag IS NOT NULL)
  AND i.tag NOT IN ('OUTROS', 'SETOR RH', 'ALMOXARIFADO', 'CANTINA', 'OFICINA', 'SUBSTAÇÃO', 'ESCRITÓRIO', 'OBRA ALMOXARIFADO', 'OBRAS', 'PORTARIA', 'BALANÇA', 'BORRACHARIA')
GROUP BY i.tag
ORDER BY total DESC
